## Spec-compliance review, round 1: PR #3, US-01-01 (head f06b45e)

**Verdict: NOT COMPLIANT.** CI run 38547165315 failed on this head. Criterion #4 (the app runs with the network off) is unmet, and criterion #5 has no recorded evidence that a signed release APK was ever built.

### CI run 38547165315 (API 31): what og-test-results holds
| Required test | Result in og-test-results |
| --- | --- |
| AC-01-01-1 (Jest, 2 tests) | pass |
| AC-01-01-3 (Jest, 2 tests) | pass |
| AC-01-01-4 (Maestro) | **FAIL**: "Assertion is false: id: content-title is visible" |
| AC-01-01-5 (Jest, 5 tests) | pass |
| TC-01-01 (Maestro) | pass |
| TC-01-02 | **absent**. DEC-44 defers it to US-03-01, so this is expected. |
| TC-01-03 | absent. It is manual-only (Kompakt). |

The earlier stories' tests (TC-00-01, TC-00-03) still pass. I ran `yarn jest` locally: 8 suites and 15 tests, all green.

**Why AC-01-01-4 fails.** The flow runs the debug build. That build loads its JavaScript from Metro at 10.0.2.2:8081, and `clearState` throws away any cached bundle. With airplane mode on, the app cannot reach Metro and shows the red "Unable to load script" screen (CI logcat: "Failed to connect to /10.0.2.2:8081"; failure screenshot `screenshots/step-006-assertCondition-content-title.png`).

The local "pass" in test-runs/2026-10-14_120331 (API 32) was a false positive. Its logcat shows `isMetroRunning(): Async result = true` (device-logcat.txt line 336) after "Turning radio off - airplane" (line 10). So locally the app still loaded its code over a network connection. DEC-44 itself says the debug build needs Metro, so this flow can never prove criterion #4 against that build.

### Criteria
| Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| #1 Foundation at its latest versions, versions recorded | met | The upgrade landed on main in US-00-01 (DEC-42). README.md has a *Platform versions* section. `tests/unit/AC-01-01-1-platform-versions.test.js` passes in CI. |
| #2 Installs and starts on an Android 12 emulator and on the Kompakt | external | Emulator part met: TC-01-01 passed in CI on API 31. Kompakt part is MANUAL TC-01-03. |
| #3 No network permission | met | `plugins/withReleaseNoNetwork.js` plus AC-01-01-3 (CI pass). The locally merged release manifest (`android/app/build/intermediates/packaged_manifests/release/.../AndroidManifest.xml`) has no INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE or ACCESS_WIFI_STATE. |
| #4 Starts and runs with the network off | **unmet** | AC-01-01-4 fails in CI (above). |
| #5 Signed release APK, key outside the repo | **missing** | AC-01-01-5 only checks how the plugin rewrites the Gradle text. Nothing recorded shows a release APK built and signed. The PR says a test key ("throwaway key") build was checked with `apksigner`, but that output is not in test-runs or CI. `android/app/build/outputs/apk/` only has `debug/`. |

### Covers check
- **MOD-01-F01**: delivered (foundation on main; TC-01-01 passes on API 31).
- **NFR-05**: delivered for the release build, as DEC-44 allows.
- **NFR-06**: the configuration is delivered (`KQ_UPLOAD_*`; no keystore tracked in git). Its build evidence is part of B2.
- **NFR-10**: delivered. The merged manifest has minSdkVersion 31 and targetSdkVersion 36.
- **NFR-12**: **not delivered**. Nothing shows the app working offline (B1).
- **NFR-13**: **not evidenced**. No signed APK was ever produced on record (B2).

### Edge case
"Device older than Android 12 is not offered the app": implemented. minSdk is 31 through `plugins/withMinSdk.js`, and the local merged manifest confirms it. The test only checks the Gradle property the plugin writes, not the built manifest or APK (N3).

### Out-of-scope and constitution
- **Out of scope:** nothing violated. The `constitution.md` *Stack* change is authorised by DEC-07 and DEC-44. No dependencies were added (package.json and yarn.lock are untouched).
- **Constitution:** the *No network* rule at `docs/specs/constitution.md:23` still says INTERNET "is removed from the manifest". DEC-44 now limits that to the release build, and that line was not updated (N2).
